topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing for the lecture by reflecting on previous practical work and introducing the learning outcomes on cancer genetics.

topics.label: Viral Origins of Oncogenes and Assays for Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the study of transforming tumor viruses revealed that oncogenes originate from normal cellular genes and led to experimental assays for testing cellular transformation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Classifications of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the classes of cancer genes and explore how specific mutations alter cell cycle checkpoints and cellular phenotype.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Cellular Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how specific defects in DNA repair, replication proofreading, and mitotic chromosome segregation produce sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep Progression, Hereditary Cancer Predisposition, and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the stepwise accumulation of mutations drives cancer progression and how inherited genetic defects accelerate tumorigenesis and influence ongoing tumor evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing for the lecture, summarizing the session, offering recommended reading, and previewing the next topic.
